excluded: Mapped Land-cover Overlap (replaced by three parsed columns)

policy.commercial_suitable_hard_block: Candidate models predicting any Commercial Suitable on validation are disqualified. Export gate blocks ZIP if any Commercial Suitable appears in test set.
policy.residential_suitable_advisory: Residential Suitable = 0 is an observed dataset characteristic. Predictions are counted and reported; no hard block applied.
policy.future_inference_enforcement: The serving layer MUST check every prediction before returning it: if Intended Purpose == Commercial and prediction == Suitable, raise a PolicyViolationError and log the event. This rule must be enforced independently of model accuracy because a passing test score does not guarantee future compliance — the model may encounter feature distributions not seen during training.

domain_notes: Suitable label is exclusive to Agricultural purpose in this reviewed dataset.
Commercial Suitable = 0 is expert-confirmed policy for this review cycle.
Residential Suitable = 0 is an observed characteristic; not a permanent block.
Predictions are preliminary research decision-support. Not zoning approval, legal availability, reservation, permit, or lease approval.
